title: Identifier
description: A property identifier with type and value. Used to identify properties across platforms (domains, app store IDs, etc.).

value.description: The identifier value. Domain and subdomain values MUST be lowercase ASCII hostnames (IDNs use lowercase A-label/punycode form), without scheme, path, port, whitespace, or trailing dot. Domain permits one leading '*.'; subdomain does not. For domain: 'example.com' matches base plus www and m; 'edition.example.com' matches that subdomain; '*.example.com' matches all subdomains but not the base. Invalid values MUST cause rejection of the containing request; receivers MUST NOT silently discard identifiers.
